graph_assumptions: Finite undirected simple graphs with vertices 0..n-1 and explicit unordered edges
C1 and C0 use F2 edge/vertex indicator chains; boundary is XOR of incident selected edges
Graphs are 1-dimensional CW complexes with no 2-cells; H1 is ker(boundary1)
Edges, vertex labels, and claimed Betti numbers are inputs whose interpretation must be independently reviewed
formal_check: For each graph, kernel is exactly the F2 span of a Gaussian-elimination basis, and that basis has unique coefficients. Explicit Lean theorems quantify every edge and coefficient Boolean.
supported_scope: 1..7 vertices, 0..8 edges, at most 4 independent F2 cycles, no loops or parallel edges. Computational limits prevent claim of a general graph theorem.
assumption_policy: No axioms, sorry, arbitrary user Lean code or native_decide. Lean kernel runs on generated closed finite facts only.
